solver.message:
The game renders correctly with the updated tile set. The task is complete.

## Summary

I updated `res://assets/tile_set.tres` to add collision shapes to the remaining solid tiles that were missing them. By visually inspecting the tile atlas (`assets/sprites/tilemap.png`) and the rendered game scene, I identified that:

- **Rows 6–8** contain the water pipe set (blue-violet pipes) and the solid green leaf blocks, but only some tiles in those groups had the standard full-tile collision polygon (`PackedVector2Array(-9, -9, 9, -9, 9, 9, -9, 9)`).

I added the same single full-tile rectangular collision polygon to the 8 tiles that were missing it:

- **Water pipe tiles**: `(8,0)`, `(10,3)`, `(11,2)`, `(11,3)` — completing the pipe set (joining `(7,2)`, `(9,0–2)`, `(10,0–2)`, `(11,0–1)` which already had collisions).
- **Solid leaf block tiles**: `(7,1)`, `(7,3)`, `(12,1)`, `(12,2)` — completing the leaf block set (joining `(7,2)`, `(8,1–2)`, `(12,0)`, `(13,0)`).

All other tiles (clouds/leaves decorations at `(4,6–8)`, `(16,6–8)`, plants, crates, pipes' decorative variants `(7,4–8)`, `(8,3–8)`, etc.) remain without collision. Verified the result with a Godot script confirming exactly 62 full-tile collision polygons, all 8 required additions present, and no unexpected changes — plus a game render confirming nothing broke.
